title: 第5章 你们父子轮着装是吧第6章 泼天的压力爹给你抗着
content_zh:
许渊一脸诧异。
看着儿子微微发抖的身体，心中有点不是滋味。
上来就是这种退婚的极致羞辱，这一剂药会不会下的太猛了些？
不过...都这样了，儿啊，你还能忍得住？
沉默片刻，他随即说：“小凡，不用怕，如果你不愿，爹为你出头！”
许小凡摇头，再次无比坚定道：“我确实配不上她！”
许渊最终只得长叹一口气。
想了想，他觉得培养儿子得一步一步来，不能操之过急。
只不过，这样一来，他确不知接下来该如何谋划了...
许小凡伸出手，迫不及待道：“爹，婚书给我！”
许渊沉思片刻后方才点头，从储物戒中，拿出婚书。
按照这个世界的规矩，退婚，互相交还婚书即可。
上官秋月脸上露出笑容，也拿出婚书，但犹豫片刻后又拿出一个玉瓷瓶，一起递给许小凡，开口道：
“此为扩脉丹，可提升资质，扩张经脉，算是补偿。”
闻言，二长老直勾勾盯着小瓷瓶，咽了一口口水。
甚至有一种想要抢夺的冲动！
一颗扩脉丹，抵得上他整个许家所有底蕴！
这谁能不心动？
当然，心动并不代表行动...
许小凡眨眨眼，有些犹豫要不要收下这丹药。

如果拿了，会不会有什么风险？
最后...他还是决定收下。
如果不拿，就会显得自己太过傲气，这与苟道不符。
还不如老老实实收下，反而百利而无一害...
况且现在当务之急，应该是赶紧把这群人打发走，然后看看系统前辈给了什么法宝！
想到这，许小凡笑着点头，伸手去接：“谢谢。”
上官秋月手停滞在半空。
少年收下与不收，其实她都不会有半分情绪波动。
可一个正在遭受退婚羞辱的废材少年，为什么要笑？
她能看出，这是发自内心，无比真诚的笑容！
好似，今日不是她上官秋月主动退婚，而是眼前的少年休妻！
这让她一时呆在原地！
然而就是这么一呆，少年与少女的手，不经意间触碰了一下。
这绝对是上官秋月长这么大以来，第一次与除了父亲以外的异性肢体接触。
即便是心上人杨飞云，也不曾有过！
上官秋月不由下意识倒退了半步...
身后，扬飞云将这一幕尽收眼底，霎时间眼底爆发出一股浓郁杀意！
他本就看这许家父子不顺眼，现在又见许小凡当着面调戏他的女人！
content_en:
Xu Yuan looked surprised.
Looking at my son's slightly trembling body, I felt a little uncomfortable.
It's the ultimate humiliation of breaking off the engagement. Is this medicine too strong?
But...it's already like this, son, can you still bear it?
After a moment of silence, he then said: "Xiao Fan, don't be afraid, if you don't want to, dad will stand up for you!"
Xu Xiaofan shook his head and said firmly again: "I really am not worthy of her!"
Xu Yuan finally had to sigh.
After thinking about it, he felt that raising his son should be done step by step and not in a hurry.
However, this way, he really doesn't know how to plan next...
Xu Xiaofan stretched out his hand and said impatiently: "Dad, give me the marriage certificate!"
Xu Yuan thought for a moment before nodding and taking out the marriage certificate from the storage ring.
According to the rules of this world, just break off the engagement and return the marriage certificate to each other.
A smile appeared on Shangguan Qiuyue's face, and she also took out the marriage certificate, but after hesitating for a moment, she took out a jade porcelain vase, handed it to Xu Xiaofan, and said:
"This is a pulse-expanding pill. It can improve your qualifications and expand your meridians, which is considered compensation."
Hearing this, the second elder stared straight at the small porcelain bottle and swallowed a mouthful of saliva.
There is even an urge to snatch it!
A pulse-expanding pill is worth all the wealth of his entire Xu family!
Who can not be moved by this?
Of course, excitement does not mean action...
Xu Xiaofan blinked, hesitant to accept the elixir.
If I take it, are there any risks?
Finally...he decided to accept it.
If you don't take it, you will appear too arrogant, which is inconsistent with the Tao.
It's better to accept it honestly, it will be beneficial without any harm...
Besides, the top priority now is to get rid of these people quickly, and then see what magic weapon the system senior has given us!
Thinking of this, Xu Xiaofan nodded with a smile and reached out to take it: "Thank you."
Shangguan Qiuyue's hand stopped in mid-air.
Whether the young man accepted it or not, she actually didn't have any mood swings at all.
But why is a good-for-nothing boy who is suffering the humiliation of breaking off his engagement laughing?
She could tell that this was a smile that came from the heart and was extremely sincere!
It seemed that today it was not Shangguan Qiuyue who took the initiative to break off the engagement, but the young man in front of her was divorcing his wife!
This made her stay in place for a moment!
However, just for a moment, the hands of the boy and the girl touched inadvertently.
This is definitely Shangguan Qiuyue's first physical contact with the opposite sex other than her father since she grew up.
Even my sweetheart Yang Feiyun has never had it!
Shangguan Qiuyue couldn't help but subconsciously took half a step back...
Behind him, Yang Feiyun had a panoramic view of this scene, and a strong murderous intent burst out from his eyes in an instant!
He already disliked the Xu family and his son, and now he saw Xu Xiaofan teasing his woman in front of him!
